name: Two-Section Prefix-Failure Class
definition: Let $R\subseteq\{0,1\}^{12}$ be the rooted 289-vertex peeling factor with root $0$ and distinguished neighbor $e=2$. On two disjoint twelve-coordinate blocks put $A=\{(r,0):r\in R\}$, $B=\{(0,0)\}\cup\{(e,r):r\in R\}$, $H=\{(0,0),(e,0)\}$, and $C_R=(A\times\{0\})\cup(B\times\{1\})$.
parameters: $|C_R|=579$ on 25 coordinates; $H$ is a coordinate edge and the two sections are nonnested.
properties: $C_R$ is dismantlable ample and has ordering width zero, but both section orders constrained to begin with $H$ have positive width.
